newsitem.title: UK: European straight-run fuel oil eases on oversupply.
newsitem.headline: European straight-run fuel oil eases on oversupply.

text.p: Straight-run fuel oil was well supplied in Europe and prices were steady to slightly weaker on Tuesday, dealers said.

About five cargoes of low sulphur straight-run were available, and offers for Oseberg quality 0.7 percent sulphur dropped to $145 fob NWE. Also, Egypt issued a spot tender for an Alexandria cargo loading in mid-December. BP won a 1997 tender for 50,000 tonnes per month of Alexandria material at benchmark quotes fob mean +$7.76, Cairo-based traders said.
Russian high sulphur cargoes continued to flow in significant volumes from the Baltic, and a cargo of low water M40 traded at the two means formula +$3.25 cif NWE.
